name: Sigma-indexed FEATURE curve driving CFG (sigma-feature)
plain: SigmaFeature turns a SIGMAS schedule into a RyanOnTheInside FEATURE: one value per step from sigma, log sigma or the step index, min-max normalized and mapped to [min_value, max_value]. SigmaFeatureCFG reads such a curve during sampling and, as a post-CFG hook, adds (s_t − s)(x̂_c − x̂_u) to the current result, so it stacks with earlier post-CFG work. The step is found by bracketing sigma in sample_sigmas; on a non-monotone schedule (restart) it does nothing. Surprises: the docstring says every mapping runs from 1 at the first step to 0 at the last, but step_index normalizes 0, 1, 2… and so runs 0 to 1; and range mode is multiplied by strength, so it is only bounded when strength is 1. It needs ComfyUI_RyanOnTheInside for the FEATURE class at run time.
math:
Feature: rᵢ = σᵢ | log σᵢ | i (trailing 0 dropped); u = (r − min r)/(max r − min r) (0.5 if flat); u ← 1 − u if invert; vᵢ = lo + u·(hi − lo).
Step: i = #(sched ≥ σ) − 1, clamped to [0, N−1] and to the curve length.
range: s_t = (cfg_min + (vᵢ − min v)/(max v − min v)·(cfg_max − cfg_min))·strength; relative: s_t = s·(1 + 2(vᵢ − 0.5)·strength); absolute: s_t = vᵢ·strength.
x̂ ← x̂ + (s_t − s)·(x̂_c − x̂_u).

props.params: SigmaFeature: mapping=linear_sigma, min_value=0, max_value=1, invert=false, drop_trailing_zero=true. SigmaFeatureCFG: mode=range, cfg_min=3, cfg_max=8, strength=1
